title: A built place, shot, flooded, scored
pitch: A brief in. A real-scale 3D street, a directed shot of it, a flood through it and a score over it.
why: The set is real geometry, so the camera move is planned, not guessed. Qwen-Image 2.1 dresses the two end frames, H3 fills between them, LTX-2.5 adds the water and its sound, and Music 3 writes the score.

fields.label: The place
fields.default: a narrow downtown street at golden hour with old brick shopfronts

models.name: Blender
models.licence: GPL, runs as a separate tool

models.name: Qwen-Image 2.1
models.note: Not Apache: read the 2.1 terms before commercial use.

tips: The brief picks the kit (street, interior or beach), the time and the weather.

steps.label: The set
steps.does: Plans the block from the brief and builds it in Blender at real scale, with textures made for it.

steps.label: The shot

shot.name: Street push-in
shot.prompt: The camera moves slowly along the empty brick street at golden hour. Warm low light, long shadows, a little dust in the air.

steps.does: Blender renders the camera path, Qwen-Image 2.1 dresses the first and last frames, and H3 fills between them.

steps.label: The flood
steps.does: LTX-2.5 runs a flood through the same clip, keeping the street and the camera move.
steps.scene: a narrow brick downtown street at golden hour

steps.label: Dry, then flooded
steps.does: Runs the two clips one after the other.

steps.label: The score
steps.does: An original instrumental for the two clips.
steps.prompt:
Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 70. key is D, and scale is minor. Dark orchestral.
Global Emotional Progression: A held low note grows into rolling drums as the water arrives.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: An empty street, then a wall of water.
Sonics & Production Profile: Huge low end, wide strings.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: No vocals. Purely instrumental.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: Low strings, timpani.
Secondary: Brass swells.
Groove & Foundation Progression: Slow steady pulse, drums enter halfway.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Swells and rises into each new section.
